question: '__________Devi Narmade' scheme has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh for the conservation of Narmada River.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Namami Devi Narmade**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Namami Devi Narmada** scheme has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh for the conservation of the Narmada River.
 
• This initiative is aimed at rejuvenating the river by addressing pollution and promoting sustainable practices.
 
• The scheme includes activities like afforestation, sewage treatment, and public awareness campaigns.
